report:
# FQ-TENSOR-LU-RIVAL-EXCLUSION

The true combining map has four coordinates u_i v_j, whereas dumpRight has two coordinates (v0+v1)u. These different codomains are retained explicitly. Colliding dump inputs e0,e1 become opposite after right-Z, so no well-defined action on the dumped report can intertwine all those inputs. A difference between two outputs alone is not called covariance failure without that collision argument.

Supported: Exact tensor/right-Z and dump/right-Z arrays plus the genuine report-action non-descent witness are native/kernel checked.

Remaining: Transport to the original abstract bilinear Kronecker interface, full local-unitary group and physical tensor/basis/inner-product admission. The rival counterexample alone does not derive the tensor product.
